liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Friend Of The Devil** (2 reviews): Listener describes the performance as absolutely epic, while noting Bertha is excellent and the playing sequence is good; The performance is described as absolutely spectacular, with no other songs disappointing the listener [13][14]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Listener praises the performance, noting they would include it on a mixed disc for a friend [4]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Pre-drums section is highlighted as the real highlight, featuring primal interaction between Bob and Jerry [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.fixed.miller.110419.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 179 min; rated 4.64/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: The song plays at a slow, half-speed pace, making it difficult to stay awake despite a perfect lead; Listener rates the show five stars, stating many released shows do not sound this good [10][11]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.miller.110400.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 179 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording has a skip in the middle of the song, specifically during the "Doctor" lyric; Listener describes the concert as excellent and praises the sound quality, thanking Mr. Miller [5][15]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.gorinsky.tetzeli.fix-6693.34260.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 161 min [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.fixed.miller.110419.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: Uploader notes all disc changes are seamless and confirms the skip in Good Lovin' was fixed [1]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.miller.110400.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [2]. Also: The skip in the recording was fixed and circulated to over 1450 downloaders via a temporary link [7]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.gorinsky.tetzeli.fix-6693.34260.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bill Golden, G. Gorinsky, and Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD>MC>R>DAT>CDR [3]
